turn_timing.ordinary_turn_use: The player chooses how to divide the minute between public speaking and eligible action and/or shot.
turn_timing.standard_hack_request: Must be requested within the same ordinary 60-second turn.
turn_timing.standard_hack_conversation_start: After the ordinary minute; next player follows its completion when requested.

end_of_round_order: Resolve the Jail vote first, before registered actions and attacks.
Resolve registered actions and attacks, including Protection and damage.
Distribute Supplier weapons if this is Round 3.
Finalize eliminations and the faction-reveal step, subject to the existing public reveal timing.
Flag whether the next round needs a Captain election.
registered_action: An action valid when registered resolves at its scheduled stage even if its actor later becomes Injured, Jailed, or Eliminated; target defenses and applicable conditions are checked at resolution.
round_5_standard_hack: Content remains undisclosed through the end of the match; players may use the answer for their own decisions without revealing or discussing the Hack content during Round 5.
captain_candidate_question: Set aside for the current playtest at the designer's request. No new fallback rule has been adopted; revisit only if the situation appears in playtesting.
